MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 22

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 120

3. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 40

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 12

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

15. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

16. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

17. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 32
   C. 9
   D. 64

18. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 15

19. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 12

20. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

21. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

22. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

23. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

24. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

25. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 170

26. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 8

27. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

28. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 37
   C. 13
   D. 36

29. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

30. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 50

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
